title: Bitcoin is Vanishing into “Deep Storage” Faster than Miners Make It
summary: ▶ Bitcoin Magazine Bitcoin is Vanishing into “Deep Storage” Faster than Miners Make It Miners produce about 450 new Bitcoin a day, but over the past year about 630 a day moved into wallets dormant for 10 years. This post Bitcoin is Vanishing into “Deep Storage” Faster than Miners Make It first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Patrick Green .
